text:
QUOTE: "Enable only `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` (which requires `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_C`), then call the setter before any allocation"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer never says the buffer allocator itself requires MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY. It says only that PLATFORM_MEMORY requires PLATFORM_C, and that is a different dependency.
